name: Ascom Holding AG
summary: Ascom Holding AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare ICT and mobile workflow solutions in Switzerland and internationally. The company offers nurse call and monitoring systems, including teleCARE IP that provides wireless nurse call, alerts, messaging, monitoring, and wander management solution; and Telligence, a patient response system.
